answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The reef is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the whisper. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the vault of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
